verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's registered agent and annual report services document reminders for annual report deadlines and real-time compliance status notifications, which meets the 'reminders before deadlines' part of the story. However, there's no evidence of a unified compliance calendar view aggregating multiple filing deadlines for legal-ops oversight. Missing for 10: dedicated calendar UI/dashboard listing all upcoming filings, evidence of reminders for filings beyond annual reports (e.g., licenses, permits), and independent confirmation the reminder system works reliably.
